intended_object: An ad hoc finset used inside a proof: the neighbours of an apex vertex t that have degree at least 5 or lie in `cherryHubs G x z y`. They are the vertices that block a particular pair-selection step in the ACMax extremal-graph counting argument.
explanation: This definition has no counterpart in the literature. It is a device for one case analysis: it is only used through bounds on its cardinality, such as `2 ≤ (badApexNbrs G x z y t).card`, in the lemmas around the cherry/apex argument. Those lemmas split into cases on whether a selection step succeeds. The body does what its docstring says: it keeps the neighbours of t that have degree at least 5 or belong to the hub set touching the cherry.
